scope: Exploratory inline SVG print-media vector traces, corroborated by the separate canonical SVG-image PNG controls. These traces are not PNG references or a claim that print and image contexts are interchangeable.

recipe.content: Inline the unchanged original CC0 SVG into a zero-margin HTML page. No external resources.
recipe.interpretation: PDF form coordinates retain the print raster scale 3.125. Inspect clip operations in the target source and alpha-mask source independently, including repeated clips. Clip arrays are left/top/right/bottom.

observations.inference: Retain parent canvas and clipped-child effect contexts separately; applying one parent coverage gives40 incorrect pixels against the canonical native image.
Mask construction retains the allocated union of target/resource bounds. A full-root construction window leaves31 incorrect pixels against the canonical native image.
